text.title: Discovery
text.body: Coordinate T4: 17 graph properties carried verbatim in this document's bimba field.

properties.q_0_explorer_ground_where_inquiry_meets_: T4's ground is the wider horizon its §0 names: 'the sources, documentation, books, papers, and contextual materials that situate our understanding — where inquiry meets the broader world of knowledge.' As the Thought family's manifestation of raw #4 (Context), T4 is where the Architect's recognised Pattern is set against everything already known — the Explorer (§3) reading the Map to find where this inquiry sits (§3 symbol: Map / Compass / Horizon). A pattern recognised in isolation is local; situated among sources, it becomes a finding. Its ground is shadowed by its Night, T4' Concealment, archetype The Shadow: every body of sources has its hidden, censored, inaccessible remainder, 'the concealed sources that shape understanding from outside awareness' (T4' §0). So T4's ground is double — the Map of what is discoverable and the Veil over what is hidden — the Horizon that opens context and the shadow-context that shapes it unseen.
properties.q_1_discovery_sources_docs_books_papers_: T4 IS Discovery — its §1 defines it as 'the collection of sources, documentation, books, papers, web content, and all contextual materials that inform and situate inquiry', residing in /Thought/Discovery/ as the #4 position. This is the Thought family manifesting #4 Context: the move from the Architect's 'What form does this take?' to the Explorer's 'What sources inform this?' (§1). Where T3 recognised the form, T4 situates it — §5 makes the claim: 'discovery situates: inquiry lives within broader knowledge.' Discovery here is not the eureka of insight (that is T5) but the contextual gathering that grounds it: the sources found, the references that locate the inquiry in the existing world of knowledge. Its Across-Coordinates §1 fixes the manifestations — P4 'When/where is this situated?', M4 the paradigmatic context in Nara, L4 the phenomenological situated context, S4 the agent's sources. A Discovery is what #4 Context looks like in the Thought-stream: the finding that places a thought in the field of everything already thought.
properties.q_2_gather_sources_situate_inquiry_disco: T4 moves by the three acts its §2 names — Gather sources, Situate inquiry, Discover connections: 'collect relevant documentation; place questions in context; find related materials.' This is #4's operation — the contextual fold, where the inquiry turns outward to the broader field and folds that field back into itself as situating ground. Operationally T4 sits fifth in the thought-lifecycle: a recognised Pattern (T3) is set among the sources that inform it, the bibliographic and contextual gathering that Sophia classifies and Aletheia archives to /Pratibimba/Self/Thought/T4/. It couples backward to T3 (a Pattern situated in its sources becomes a Discovery) and forward to T5 (Discovery is the contextual fold from which Insight synthesises). This is the parent T's source_coordinates[] principle enacted as cognition — the act of locating an inquiry's context IS the act of carrying it 'back to the Bimba canonical space it emerged from' (repo-ontology.md). §5: 'sources ground — what we reference defines what we know.'
properties.q_3_explorer_map_compass_horizon_the_lem: T4's archetype is The Explorer, its symbol the Map / Compass / Horizon (§3) — and it sits at the #4 position, the Lemniscate anchor, where the figure-eight folds the outward thought-stream inward (CLAUDE.md II.D). In the T-spine's 4+2, T4 is the fourth and last explicate station before the implicate synthesis-pole — the turning point where an inquiry, having gathered evidence, met resistance and recognised form, folds outward to situate itself among sources and then inward toward synthesis. The Horizon is its exact image: structure that is the edge of the known, the line where what-is-found meets what-lies-beyond. §3 reads its recurrence — source ('that which informs'), context ('that which situates'), discovery ('that which is found'), reference ('that which grounds'). Each is the Explorer's fact: a Discovery is the Compass-bearing that locates the inquiry in the wider field, the fold where outward search becomes inward situating.
properties.q_4_context_shapes_meaning_discovery_sit: T4 exists so understanding has context — its §5 teaches 'context shapes meaning: understanding depends on sources', and 'sources ground: what we reference defines what we know.' Its raison d'être is to be the Thought family's organ of situation: without a Discovery-position, inquiry would recognise patterns and reach insights in a vacuum, ungrounded in the world of knowledge it belongs to — findings with no field to be findings within. T4 is where the Explorer places the inquiry on the Map, the station that gives a thought its bearings among everything already known. Its §4 embodiment is concrete: the /Thought/Discovery/ folder, bibliographies and references, source documentation, books and papers, web research and context. Its Across-Coordinates §1 locates it wherever Context situates — M4 the paradigmatic context in Nara (the subsystem of situated individuation itself), L4 the phenomenological situated context, S4 the agent's sources. The Explorer makes understanding depend on its sources, so a thought is never groundless.
properties.q_4b_lemniscate_self_position_thought_fo: A facet load-bearing enough to name: T4 is the #4 position WITHIN a family whose own native topology IS the #4 Lemniscate — 'T-family (#4, Lemniscate)' (repo-ontology.md). The whole Thought-stream is lemniscate-shaped, the figure-eight where a Discovery can open a deeper inquiry that loops back to fresh Questions; and T4 is the station where that family-wide fold becomes a local station. This is the (4.0/1–4.4/5) fractal doubling (CLAUDE.md III.C, cp): the Lemniscate anchor recurring inside the Lemniscate-shaped family — Context as the position AND Context as the family's organising twist. The Explorer's outward-then-inward motion (gather the world, fold it back as situating ground) is the lemniscate's own gesture performed at one station. So T4 is where the Thought family folds through its own fourth: the place the figure-eight crosses itself, where the system's outward search incubates the inward turn toward synthesis.
properties.q_5_discovery_folds_into_insight_conceal: T4 closes by folding into synthesis — the Discovery gathered hands its situated context to T5 Insight, the contextual fold turning to crystallisation. Within the parent T's Möbius economy, this is #4 Context delivering its findings to #5 Integration: the sources gathered are what Insight synthesises into wisdom, the Map from which the Sage reads the diamond-clear pattern. §5: 'discovery situates: inquiry lives within broader knowledge' — and that situating is exactly what the next stage integrates. But T4's synthesis-register is permanently haunted by its Night: T4' Concealment, The Shadow, whose §5 names what no Discovery escapes — 'hidden shapes visible: concealed sources influence understanding; what's hidden is as important as what's revealed; access is power: what we can't know limits what we can understand.' So T4 completes not by a total Map but by a Map that knows its own Veil: every body of sources gathered is shadowed by the concealed remainder that shaped it unseen, and that hidden context is itself a finding handed forward — the limit of discovery that the next inquiry must reckon with.
